title: Solstice save contract
description: Save file envelope. Truth: docs/TECH.md SS2.2 (versioning) and docs/LATER.md SS4 (import/export). The envelope is authoritative now; snapshot / card_history / chronicle payloads tighten at M1 (docs/TECH.md SS5). Sample: shared/fixtures/save.sample.json.

version.description: Save format version. Bump on any breaking payload change; a loader migrates older versions upward (docs/TECH.md SS2.2).

meta.description: Envelope metadata. realm_id must name a preset from world.json (default or presets).

snapshot.description: World state payload (terrain / water / life). Shape is settled at M1; the envelope only fixes the container.

card_history.description: Cards played on this realm, in play order (M1).
